prompt: A Pro subscription was created with multi-zone replication. Which changes can the team NOT make to the running subscription?
explanation: Zone settings are locked at Pro subscription creation: you cannot convert a multi-zone subscription to single-zone or vice versa, and the availability-zone selection cannot be changed once the subscription is active. Using different zone settings requires a new subscription plus data migration. Per-database replication can be toggled on or off for each database at any time, and database sizing (such as memory limit) is editable, so those are not locked.

options.text: Convert the subscription from multi-zone to single-zone
Select different availability zones for the subscription's clusters
Turn replication on or off for an individual database in the subscription
